notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Thank you so much for bug reports. It is very supportive.
Sorry for ruining some players' experience

Bug fixed:
[list]
[*] Result not update correctly
[*] Reduce random crash (might still happen)
[*] Some Grimoire events are too dark
[*] Some cards have wrong name
[*] Staff of loop cast do not work correctly
[/list]

I hope you enjoy the game.
